timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So BCDR. We just need backups, right? Problem solved?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Backups are one piece. BCDR is three phases: protect, detect, recover.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What do you mean by protect?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Availability zones, redundancy, making sure your infrastructure survives a failure.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Monitoring and alerts. You need to know something went wrong immediately.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about recover? That's the backup part?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Azure Site Recovery for VMs, Azure Backup for data. Recovery Services Vault ties it together.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What are RPO and RTO? More acronyms?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: RPO is max data you can lose. RTO is max time you can be down. Define them upfront.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: And testing? We tested once, years ago.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: An untested plan is a wish. Test quarterly, or plan to fail when it matters most.
